name: meridian-shards
description: Meridian Shards: a faithful browser port of the Meridian 59 client.

scripts.desktop:start: npm run build && npm run build -w @shards/desktop && npm run start -w @shards/desktop
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm run build -w @shards/desktop && npm run pack -w @shards/desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm run build -w @shards/desktop && npm run dist -w @shards/desktop
scripts.desktop:release: npm run build && npm run build -w @shards/desktop && npm run release -w @shards/desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/client/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
